column3: WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM n WHERE i < 5) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n
WITH RECURSIVE ex AS (SELECT id, arr, 0 AS n FROM arrtab WHERE JSON_LENGTH(arr) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, arr, n+1 FROM ex WHERE n+1 < JSON_LENGTH(arr)) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ex

WITH RECURSIVE ex AS (SELECT id, arr, 0 AS n FROM arrtab WHERE JSON_LENGTH(arr) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, arr, n+1 FROM ex WHERE n+1 < JSON_LENGTH(arr)) SELECT SUM(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(arr, CONCAT('$[', n, ']')) AS SIGNED)) FROM ex

WITH RECURSIVE ex AS (SELECT id, arr, 0 AS n, JSON_EXTRACT(arr,'$[0]') AS v FROM arrtab WHERE JSON_LENGTH(arr) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, arr, n+1, JSON_EXTRACT(arr, CONCAT('$[', n+1, ']')) FROM ex WHERE n+1 < JSON_LENGTH(arr)) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id,':',v) ORDER BY id, n) FROM ex

WITH RECURSIVE ex AS (SELECT id, arr, 0 AS n FROM arrtab WHERE JSON_LENGTH(arr) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, arr, n+1 FROM ex WHERE n+1 < JSON_LENGTH(arr)) SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(arr, CONCAT('$[', n, ']')) AS SIGNED)) FROM ex WHERE id=1

WITH RECURSIVE ex AS (SELECT id, arr, 0 AS n FROM arrtab WHERE JSON_LENGTH(arr) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, arr, n+1 FROM ex WHERE n+1 < JSON_LENGTH(arr)) SELECT id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(arr, CONCAT('$[', n, ']')) AS SIGNED) * 2) FROM ex WHERE CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(arr, CONCAT('$[', n, ']')) AS SIGNED) > 15 GROUP BY id
